description: Patches-file source coverage: a single package with a single patch; a package declared in compact (description->url) form inside the file; a file whose top-level JSON is an empty object (no patches key -> no_patches_found); a file whose JSON is a bare array (still missing the patches key -> no_patches_found); a completely non-JSON body (-> invalid_json); and a valid file where two patches for one package share a url and collapse to one via de-duplication. The output reports either the normalized error category or the per-package counts and patched-package list.
